sources.verified_angle_summary: At LEAP 2026, LIVE4WELL demonstrated its advanced AI-driven preventive health platform, marking a significant shift from passive treatment to proactive health management. The platform integrates multi-country testing technologies, utilizing scientific assessment, digital monitoring, and personalized AI insights. A key feature is its AI retinal screening, which uses fundus imaging to analyze retinal texture patterns, delivering risk grading for 55 health risk factors—including brain degeneration and arteriosclerosis—in just 30 seconds. Additionally, the platform offers a stress-resilience assessment that applies AI eye-tracking and visual stimulation to measure five mental health indices in 90 seconds. This distinct healthtech announcement highlights practical, non-invasive AI applications in preventive healthcare showcased during the event.
